purpose: Define each security/privacy/governance incident as an explicit case identity separate from alerts, Events, errors, audit records and remediation operations.

topics.name: Security and Governance Incident Identity
topics.purpose: Define each security/privacy/governance incident as an explicit case identity separate from alerts, Events, errors, audit records and remediation operations.

semantics.identity_rule: Each incident has an explicit stable identity.
semantics.ownership_rule: Incident coordination ownership is explicit and does not imply resource semantic ownership.
semantics.authority_rule: Incident existence grants no remediation rights by itself.

invariants.rule: Policy, decision, evidence, audit record, consent, incident and compliance result remain separate machine-significant identities; no evidence artifact silently becomes source data, authorization or runtime authority.

Ambiguous or unresolved governance for protected data fails closed; UI visibility, transport reachability, cache presence, role title, prior access or audit-log presence never substitute for an explicit valid policy decision.

hard_gates.condition: alert id reused as incident identity
